title: Authentication Login API Contract
description: Draft USF-native interface contract for an authentication login boundary, source-backed by historical OpenAPI and authentication proof evidence.
aiGuidance: Keep the contract USF-native per ADR 0002. Do not claim OpenAPI compliance from this instance alone.
purpose: Represent the authenticated login boundary as a governed contract before implementation extraction.

requestContract.description: Login request semantics are source-backed but not yet expanded into field-level USF schema.

responseContract.description: Login response semantics are source-backed but not yet expanded into field-level USF schema.

security: Authentication boundary must preserve fail-closed authorization defaults and audited session creation.
